It was specifically designed and recommended for systems involving transition metal bonding. Conversely, M06-2X is a hybrid functional (Hybrid Meta-GGA, Rung 4) containing a high percentage (54%) of Hartree-Fock exchange, and is recommended for main-group thermochemistry, kinetics (barrier heights), and non-covalent interactions.
